intro.h2: Everything cabinet related, made in Yuba City
paragraphs: King Custom Cabinets builds custom cabinets in Yuba City for whole kitchens, islands and the small extras that make a kitchen work. We have built crisp white shaker kitchens, deep navy islands, black cabinets around a granite island and stained wood bases for a farmhouse sink.

Some jobs ask for more than style. After a fire burned through one home, we designed the cabinets to replicate exactly what the house looked like before. A recent customer loved her shaker cabinets, the paint and the extra spice rack we added, and called the install speedy. Fast production with quality intact is how we like to work.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Full kitchens built to your layout, from upper and base cabinets to the island in the middle. We produce them quickly and deliver without sacrificing quality, so your kitchen is not torn apart for longer than it has to be.

image.alt: White shaker upper and base cabinets with marble-look countertop and backsplash around a stainless range

items.name: Shaker and painted cabinets
items.blurb: We have built shaker cabinets in white, grey and navy, and painted kitchens in black. A customer praised the craftsmanship and the paint on her shaker cabinets. We can also add touches like a pull-out spice rack.

items.name: Kitchen islands
items.blurb: An island is often the centerpiece of a remodel. We build large islands with doors, drawers and open storage on both sides, painted or stained to match or contrast with the rest of your kitchen.

image.alt: Long navy blue shaker kitchen island with open doors and birch interiors during installation

items.name: Fire and rebuild cabinet matching
items.blurb: Rebuilding after a fire is hard enough. For one home that burned, we designed the cabinets to replicate exactly what the home looked like before the fire, so the family got their kitchen back as they knew it.

items.title: Cabinets are all we focus on
items.text: Our Facebook page says it best: we specialize in everything cabinet related. That focus shows in the details, from paint finish to the spice rack added to one customer's kitchen.

items.title: Quick production, quality kept
items.text: We aim for rapid production and delivery without sacrificing quality. One customer called the install speedy, and another review lists punctuality, quality and value.

items.title: Competitive prices
items.text: A customer who loves her shaker cabinets also mentioned our competitive prices and said she would definitely refer us. Custom does not have to mean out of reach.

items.title: We can match what was there
items.text: When a fire took a home's kitchen, we designed the new cabinets to look exactly like the old ones. If you need your old kitchen back, tell us what it looked like.

about.text: King Custom Cabinets is a cabinet shop at 367 Burns Dr in Yuba City, California. We specialize in everything cabinet related, and our Facebook page shows the range: a stunningly elegant black kitchen around a granite island, showroom-ready kitchens produced and delivered fast, stained wood bases for a farmhouse sink and navy shaker islands. Some of our most meaningful work has been rebuilding after loss, like the home where we designed cabinets to replicate exactly what was there before a fire. Customers on Google mention craftsmanship, punctuality, quality and value.

image.alt: Kitchen island with stained cabinets and open drawer boxes during installation, with a brick backsplash wall behind

steps.title: Call or visit the shop
steps.text: Call (530) 845-2614 or come by 367 Burns Dr. Tell us about your kitchen, your style and any photos you love.

steps.title: Design the layout
steps.text: We work out the cabinets, island and storage for your room, plus extras like a spice rack, and choose the door style and finish.

steps.title: Build in our shop
steps.text: Your cabinets are produced in our shop in the finish you chose, whether painted shaker, black, navy or stained wood.

steps.title: Deliver and install
steps.text: We deliver and install the cabinets so your countertops can go on next. Customers have described the install as speedy.

items.text: I absolutely love my shaker cabinets!  Great craftmanship, paint, the extra spice rack he added!   Competitive prices 😎  I would def refer them 👍🏼🙏🙏 speedy instal!!! …

service_area.text: Our cabinet shop is at 367 Burns Dr #3 in Yuba City, CA, and our Facebook page lists Yuba City as home. We build cabinets for kitchens and islands for homeowners and for rebuilds. If you are outside Yuba City and wondering whether we can take on your project, call (530) 845-2614 and tell us where you are and what you need.

items.q: What kinds of cabinets do you make?
items.a: Everything cabinet related: full kitchens, islands, painted shaker cabinets in white, grey and navy, black painted kitchens, and stained wood cabinets such as a farmhouse sink base. Small custom touches like an added spice rack are part of the job too. Call and tell us what you have in mind.

It depends on the size of the kitchen and the finish, so we give you a timeline when we plan your job. Our goal is rapid production and delivery without sacrificing quality, and customers have mentioned punctuality and a speedy install.

items.q: Can you match cabinets after a fire or damage?
items.a: Yes. For a home that burned, we designed cabinets to replicate exactly what the home looked like before the fire. Bring us photos of your old kitchen and we will talk through how close we can get to the original look.

A customer who had shaker cabinets made called our prices competitive, and another review lists value among our strengths. Every kitchen is priced from its own layout, door style and finish, so call (530) 845-2614 to talk about your project.

Our hours are not listed on Google yet, so the best way to reach us is to call (530) 845-2614 before coming by the shop at 367 Burns Dr #3 in Yuba City. That way you can set a time to talk through your kitchen, your layout and the finishes you like.
